posts.title: Getting Started with Goravel
posts.excerpt: Build a small REST API with Goravel, migrations, validation, and services.
posts.content_html:
Goravel gives Go applications a Laravel-style structure for routing, controllers, services, ORM models, and database migrations.

This seeded post is published so the public Nuxt feed has content to render.

posts.title: Nuxt Frontend for the Goravel API
posts.excerpt: Connect Nuxt pages to the Goravel blog and authentication REST endpoints.
posts.content_html:
The Nuxt frontend consumes the Goravel API for public posts, authenticated author workflows, taxonomy management, and comment moderation.

Seeded content makes local integration checks easier after migrations.

posts.title: Draft API Testing Checklist
posts.excerpt: A draft article visible only to its author in the dashboard.
posts.content_html: Keep endpoint tests isolated, avoid truncating shared tables, and verify authentication flows with realistic fixtures.
